title: Disclosure Day: Everything You Need to Know
excerpt: Steven Spielberg’s Disclosure Day follows a global UFO conspiracy, and streams on Peacock starting October 9.
content:
It's hard to believe, but legendary director Steven Spielberg hadn't graced movie-goers with a science fiction film featuring aliens or UFOs since 2005's War of the Worlds. Thankfully, that ended with last June's release of Universal Picture's Disclosure Day. And now, you can stream the film exclusively on Peacock.

Based on an original story idea by director Spielberg, the Disclosure Day screenplay was written by his frequent collaborator David Koepp (Jurassic Park, War of the Worlds). The story takes place on a global scale, and continues Spielberg's ongoing cinematic fascination with exploring the possibility of whether there are UFOs out in the universe, and what would happen if there was first contact?

Find out more about Disclosure Day's intriguing premise, the incredible cast, and its Peacock streaming debut, below.

Is Disclosure Day streaming on Peacock?

Yes, Steven Spielberg's Disclosure Day is now streaming, only on Peacock.

What is Disclosure Day about?

Disclosure Day finds a TV weatherperson and a cybersecurity analyst driven to expose a long-entrenched government cover-up of extraterrestrial life.

The official Disclosure Day website queries, "If you found out we weren’t alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you? This summer, the truth belongs to eight billion people. We are coming close to … Disclosure Day. "

In the film's trailer, cybersecurity administrator Daniel Kellner (Josh O'Connor) admits to stealing secrets about non-humans that he was hired to hide from the world. When meteorologist Margaret Fairchild (Emily Blunt) starts speaking in clicks on live television, it gets broadcast everywhere, and Kellner says he can understand what she's communicating. He implies that he wants to provide full disclosure to the whole world. What does that actually mean? Disclosure Day has the answers.

Who is in the Disclosure Day cast?

Spielberg has assembled another A-list cast including Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer), Josh O'Connor (Challengers), Colin Firth (Lockerbie: A Search for Truth), Coleman Domingo (Wicked: For Good), Wyatt Russell (Thunderbolts) and Eve Hewson (Bridge of Spies). 

Emily Blunt

Blunt plays Margaret Fairchild, a Kansas City TV meteorologist who battles to expose the government's alien secrets.

Josh O'Connor 

O'Connor plays Dr. Daniel Kellner, a cybersecurity specialist who becomes the main whistleblower about the cover-up. 

Colin Firth

Firth plays Noah Scanlon, head of the Wardex Corporation, a clandestine U.S. government contractor protecting secrets about alien life and technology.

Eve Hewson 

Hewson plays Jane Blankenship, Daniel's girlfriend and a former religious novice, who has her own ties to the alien technology at the heart of the conspiracy.

Colman Domingo 

Domingo plays Hugo Wakefield, the former Wardex Director of Biological Assets who tries to assist Margaret and Daniel in exposing the cover-up.

Wyatt Russell

Russell plays Margaret's boyfriend, Jackson.

How long is Disclosure Day?

The runtime for Disclosure Day is 2 hours and 25 minutes.

Is Disclosure Day a sequel?

Though it has similar alien DNA to some of his past films, Disclosure Day is not a sequel.

Disclosure Day probably has the closest connection to Close Encounters of the Third Kind, but it is not directly connected to Spielberg's alien classic from 1977. However, in an interview featured in the June 2026 edition of Empire Magazine, Blunt confirmed a thematic connection when she said, “There are definitely questions posed by Close Encounters that are answered in Disclosure Day."

Koepp added that Disclosure Day has a different tonal vibe than Spielberg's 1977 sci-fi classic. “It has a certain amount in common with certain ’70s conspiracy thrillers but in a completely different way from Close Encounters. This felt like Three Days Of The Condor to me. Conspiracies are fantastic for movies because they’re an onion, and you peel away layers and find out more and more."

Where was Disclosure Day filmed?

Most of Disclosure Day was filmed around New York and New Jersey, which stood in for America's East Coast and Midwest in the film. 

How can I watch Disclosure Day at home?

Steven Spielberg's Disclosure Day is now streaming, only on Peacock.
